title: iOS build library
description: Choose the staged folder of exported IPA builds. Save here to finish setup.

library_root.title: Build library folder
library_root.warning: This path is not sandboxed. Anyone with KiwiOS on your tailnet can view its builds. Choose a folder you intend to share.

sort.title: Sort valid builds
sort.description: Sort order for the builds table.

keep_days.title: Delete builds older than (days)
keep_days.description: Clean Old Builds deletes valid build folders older than this age. 0 disables age cleanup.

max_gb.title: Keep library under (GB)
max_gb.description: Cleanup deletes oldest build folders until the library fits. 0 = no size limit.
